newsitem.title: USA: TCI Communications Digital-TV VP resigns.
newsitem.headline: TCI Communications Digital-TV VP resigns.

text.p: TCI Communications Inc said Friday that it had accepted the resignation of its senior vice president of Digital TV and corporate marketing, Camille Jayne.
The company said in a statement that Jayne had accepted a position as senior partner with BHC Consulting, a management consulting and market research firm in Oakland, California.
"Jayne has assisted the company in identifying her successor and will continue to consult with the company during a transition of her responsibilities," the statement said.
The company did not provide the names of any potential successors in the statement and did not immediately return a call seeking more details.
